prompts.name: Young woman
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single-image reference for reconstructing a realistic 3D head in Tripo, for an 1896 New York patient character library.
Scene/backdrop: completely plain uniform light neutral gray studio background.
Composition: one single isolated head and complete neck, centered, square format. Entire bald skull and both ears clearly visible, crop at the base of the neck just above the collarbones, no chest or torso. Face directly forward, eye level, long-lens almost orthographic view, gaze straight ahead.
Style: highly realistic unretouched digital-human scan reference, ordinary individual features, natural skin pores and believable subtle asymmetry. Natural-sized cranium, proportionate lower face, anatomically plausible jaw and chin.
Lighting: broad diffuse neutral studio illumination, evenly exposed skin, very soft shadows, clear readable facial geometry.
Constraints: fully bald scalp, natural eyebrows, no beard or moustache, no makeup, no jewellery, no glasses, no hats or clothing, no floating parts. Both eyes naturally open with normal eyelids; lips gently closed exactly along their natural join, no smile, no visible teeth, no fixed emotion. Neutral relaxed facial muscles. Single frontal view only, no collage, no text or labels, no watermark.
Subject: a fictional European American young adult woman aged eighteen. A gently rounded oval face with youthful cheek fullness, a relatively short lower face, a small rounded chin and softly defined jaw, a modest straight nose with a gently rounded tip, normally spaced hazel eyes, light-brown natural eyebrows, fair neutral skin with a few faint freckles. Her face should be recognizably youthful and individual, with ordinary rather than fashion-model proportions.

prompts.name: Shirtwaist and skirt
prompts.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: full-body reference for Tripo reconstruction and humanoid rigging of an 1896 New York game character.
Scene/backdrop: plain uniform light neutral gray studio backdrop with only a very faint contact shadow.
Composition: one isolated complete person, centered in a portrait canvas; whole bald head and both boots entirely visible with a generous safety margin, eye-level long-lens near-orthographic frontal view. Upright symmetrical relaxed A-pose, arms angled about 30 degrees away from the torso, elbows straight but relaxed, hands clear of clothing, palms facing the camera and all five natural fingers readable. Feet parallel about hip-width apart.
Style: photorealistic museum garment reconstruction on a realistic human body, subdued natural colours, accurate real cloth volume, seams, small buttons, drape and material grain. Plausible human anatomy, natural shoulder/upper-arm/forearm volume and wrist taper, normal head-to-body proportions roughly 7.5 heads tall, moderate waist. Soft even neutral studio light, readable forms without strong baked shadows.
Constraints: one single frontal view, no collage, no captions or labels, no watermark, no scenery or props. No hat, spectacles, jewellery, bag, brooch, necktie or scarf; these will be separate game accessories. No modern zippers, modern sneakers, stretch-fabric appearance, cartoon anatomy, huge head or tiny corset waist. Hands empty and unoccluded, neutral expression. The bald placeholder head will later be replaced by an independently generated expressive head.
Subject: a normally proportioned young adult woman aged twenty-two with a medium-slender build, a modest waist and neutral beige skin, in an accurately reconstructed mid-1890s shirtwaist and skirt. Ivory cotton shirtwaist with a small neat standing collar, a simple vertical row of small buttons and fine front tucks, moderate leg-of-mutton fullness confined to the upper sleeves with fitted forearms and neat cuffs. Tucked into a clearly separate dark slate-blue wool gored skirt, natural waist-level narrow waistband, fitted smoothly over the hips and widening gently toward a plain ankle-length hem. Black low-heeled lace-up ankle boots visible below the hem. Subtle cotton weave and matte wool grain, physically coherent shoulder and elbow folds, carefully fitted neckline and wrists. Plain practical everyday clothing suitable for a pupil, teacher or stenographer, no apron or extra ornament.

prompts.name: Plain working dress
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied full-body female A-pose reference. Preserve exactly the same bald placeholder person, age, head-to-body proportions, body anatomy, stance, arm angles, exposed hands, fingers, boots, frontal camera, lighting and plain gray background. Change only the clothing to a plain practical American women's working dress appropriate to 1896: muted warm umber fine cotton with very subtle small woven checks, a modest fitted bodice and moderate waist seam, a small plain band collar, small centered front buttons, long sleeves with restrained shoulder fullness and natural elbow and forearm volume, neat cuffs, and a full but practical ankle-length skirt with believable gathers and modest folds. Plain hem clear of the floor so both black ankle boots remain visible. Readable cotton texture and sewn construction, clean functional clothes with very slight edge wear. No apron, cap, scarf, jewellery or other accessories: optional aprons will be separate fitted components. No large stains, patches, ruffles, modern fasteners or exaggerated narrow waist. One single full-body frontal photorealistic reconstruction image, no text or labels.

prompts.name: Frock-coat day ensemble
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied full-body male A-pose reference.
